criteria.description: Continuation forms a coherent standalone tweet with the prefix 'i forgot how my grandma's hand ' — grammatically completes the sentence/fragment and makes sense as one tweet, without repeating the prefix, adding a link/hashtag, or discussing the task.

Preserves casual, lowercase, intimate voice and stance; uses a specific, concrete image, sensory detail, or distinctive joke about the hand (texture, action, memory). Generic hyperbole like 'one of the most miserable experiences ever' or 'never again lol' without distinctive detail is weaker.

Economical and natural at roughly 16 words for the continuation (ideally 10-22 words) and full tweet including prefix is <=280 characters; reads like a real tweet with deliberate informality, fragments, '..', slashes allowed, not overly polished or wordy.
